title: Blog outline: Why WordPress homepages score higher on AI readiness
why: Insight lab 2026-W44, candidate 1 (medium): WordPress +6.9 readiness points, explained by SEO-plugin schema defaults. n=213, 26 Oct 2026, purposive sample. Waits for the blog proposal to be approved.
body:
# Why WordPress homepages score higher on AI readiness (and what that says about defaults)

## The finding
- 213 homepages of small and mid-size B2B SaaS, agency and professional-services sites, scanned 26 Oct 2026.
- WordPress 84.5 (n=93) vs all other platforms 77.6 (n=120). Gap 6.9 points, bootstrap 95% interval 3.7 to 10.2.
- Within professional services: +8.9 (39 vs 31), interval 3.8 to 14.0. Within SaaS the WordPress group is 9 sites: no conclusion.

## Where the points come from
- Organization/WebSite schema 95% vs 68%; content schema 73% vs 27%; JSON-LD present 97% vs 72%.
- Schema checks: 14.1 vs 8.9 points on average (+5.2 of the 6.9).
- Crawler access goes the other way: 17.3 vs 19.0 of 26 points.

## The mechanism: plugins write schema by default
- 15 of 20 WordPress homepages rechecked the same day ran Yoast (9) or Rank Math (6). All 9 Yoast homepages carried BreadcrumbList.
- What this does not show: whether any AI system weighs a homepage BreadcrumbList. The scan measures readiness, not mentions.

## What to do on a site without that default
- Webflow, headless and custom builds: add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD by hand (name, url, logo, sameAs).
- WordPress: confirm the plugin's schema output is on and the organization name and logo are filled in.
- Link: /tools (schema generator).

## Related research
- /research/state-of-ai-readiness (219 well-known sites, July 2026: content schema missing on 76.7% of homepages).
- /research/crawler-access-2026 (2190 site-crawler pairs, 2% blocked).

## Run the scan
- Free scan on the homepage, with UTM per channel when published.

## Method note
- Purposive sample found by web search, not random; homepage only; one scan each from a data-center address; platform detected from page source. 24 failed, 7 skipped by robots.txt. Confidence: medium.
